coast.rule: Retain exact clipped vector coordinates. Raster representation has predeclared6000m samplebudget; detailed source remains available. No source shoreline is snapped to tile edges.

islands.rule: Protected large island interiors must remain land in both canonical and detailed water masks. Subpixel islands are a declared cartographic omission limit, not surveyed absence.

river_network.rule: Retain every intersecting feature and exact clipped source coordinates; clipping at regional edge expected. No fictional network completion; source missing small streams remains unknown.

ridges.rule: Native15s detail uses unchanged source heights at source cell centers, preserving all sampled heightfield features. Coarser levels allowed only measured budget reduction. These are ridge/massif test anchors, not a newly surveyed ridge line network.

tile_seams.rule: One global canonical raster; adjacent renderpatches must sample identical geography. Logical tile IDs floor projected metres/1000 and are zoom-independent. Runtime probes required separately.
